name: Women's Class B blue short-sleeve blouse and skirt (nametag position only): USAF aide de camp aiguillette cord (silver, single loop, chrome tip) (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female)
size_basis: Same box as garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female; 0.36 in braid following the wearer's left armhole seam; colours from assets/cords/cord-aide-de-camp.spec.json. The regulation gives no cord dimension. Aiguillette parts (loop, whipping, thin cord, pencil tip) are drawn as the overlay's own groups: proportions in braid thicknesses B (0.36 in here) from Vanguard SKU 3710210 (assets/cords/ref/README.md): free loop 5.9 x 4.7 B outer = 2.1 x 1.7 in, an oval with its inner edge on the run, whipping 0.9 x 2.6 B, thin cord 3.9 B long and 0.14 B thick, pencil tip 1.2 in (4.1 B at the 0.30 in braid of cord-aide-de-camp), so the tip point hangs about 4.0 in below the contact point. Where the loop leaves the run (1.9 in down the run from its shoulder end) is estimated.
landmarks_note: polygons are [[x,y]...] in user units (0.01 in); aiguillette_loop, aiguillette_pendant: {x,y} top-left of the box in user units, w_in/h_in in inches (pendant = loop + whipping + thin cord + tip, the keep-clear box); aiguillette_tip: {x,y} the tip point, head_x/head_y the cup end where the thin cord enters, len_in, hang_deg (the pendant is rotated this many degrees clockwise about the loop contact point so it hangs along the run slope), box = the tip's own bounding box
documented: shoulder cords are worn on the left shoulder aligned along the shoulder seam, underneath the epaulet (CAPR 39-1 9.3)

CAPR 39-1 9.3.4: the USAF Aide de Camp Shoulder Cord is worn on the left sleeve, only on the Service and Service Dress uniforms; DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1 describes it as a single-loop aiguillette with a chrome tip
assumed: loop, whipping and thin-cord proportions read from one product photo (Vanguard SKU 3710210, screenshot 800 x 667)
loop touches the run 1.9 in below its shoulder end, tip on the chest about 3.2 in below that contact point
